description: Source code for the ISM330DHCX 6-axis IMU sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, configuration, data fetching, and conversion functions.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_freq_to_odr_val
methods.description: Converts frequency in Hz to ODR register value.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_odr_to_freq_val
methods.description: Converts ODR register value to frequency in Hz.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_accel_range_to_fs_val
methods.description: Maps accelerometer range in g to full scale register value.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_gyro_range_to_fs_val
methods.description: Maps gyroscope range in dps to full scale register value.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_accel_odr_set
methods.description: Configures accelerometer ODR based on frequency.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_gyro_odr_set
methods.description: Configures gyroscope ODR based on frequency.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes based on channel and attribute type.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor data for specified channel.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_accel_convert
methods.description: Converts raw accelerometer data to sensor_value.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_gyro_convert
methods.description: Converts raw gyroscope data to sensor_value.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_gyro_channel_get_temp
methods.description: Gets temperature data from gyroscope channel.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_magn_convert
methods.description: Converts raw magnetometer data to sensor_value.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_hum_convert
methods.description: Converts raw humidity data to sensor_value.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_press_convert
methods.description: Converts raw pressure data to sensor_value.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_temp_convert
methods.description: Converts raw temperature data to sensor_value.
